basic_info.description: Welcome to 166 Bonview Streetclassic charm in the heart of Bernal Heights.  Discover the perfect blend of timeless San Francisco character and modern comfort in this delightful 2-bedroom, 1-bath home located in one of the city's most coveted neighborhoods. Spanning 1,043 sq. ft., this residence captures the essence of Bernal Heights living with its warm ambiance, vintage details, and inviting spaces.  Step through the curved doorways into a bright living room adorned with a cozy fireplace, and built-in bookcasesthe perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. The formal dining room and breakfast nook offer flexible options for both everyday meals and special gatherings. Beautiful wood floors and classic architectural touches flow throughout, creating a cohesive and elegant feel.  The stained-glass window in the sunroom provides a tranquil escape for enjoying San Francisco's sunshine. A single-car garage adds convenience to parking or extra storage in this vibrant urban setting.  Situated on an elevated street, 166 Bonview offers both peaceful surroundings and easy access to the best of Bernal Heights, including Cortland Avenue's cafes, boutiques, parks, and scenic Bernal Hill trails.
